title: The World's Smallest Bear Has a 10-Inch Tongue for Honey
subject: sun bear

scenes.text: The smallest bear in the world has a tongue longer than a dinner knife.
The sun bear weighs about as much as a large dog, roughly 30 to 80 kilograms.
Its tongue stretches up to 25 centimeters, nearly 10 inches.
It climbs trees in Southeast Asia with long curved claws and breaks into wild bee nests.
Then the tongue goes in, deep into the crevice, and pulls out honey and insects.

description:
The smallest bear in the world has a tongue up to 25 centimeters long.
The sun bear uses it, with long curved claws, to pull honey and insects out of tree cavities and bee nests.
Would you trust that tongue near your honey?
first_comment: Would you rather share honey with a sun bear or a grizzly?
